notes.title: Delicious Update 1
notes.content:
Delicious update on the demo :

Thank you very much for playing the demo!
With your Feedback we were able to fix some bugs and make some improvements in the game (and in the demo as well).

- The piece that Jajazinho shoots is now faster and reaches longer distances.
- Fixed a bug that allowed the player to do through the ground on Level 4 of the demo.
- Small ajusts in some enemies and objects.

Be with the delicious! ÚH!
